def index_bundle(self, bundle, force=False):
        """
        Indexes a bundle/dataset and all of its partitions
        :param bundle: A bundle or dataset object
        :param force: If true, index the document even if it already exists
        :return:
        """
        if not isinstance(bundle, Bundle):
            raise ValueError("Bundle must be a Bundle object")

        if not force and self.exists(bundle.id):
            return

        # Index the bundle
        self.index(bundle)

        # Index all of the partitions
        for partition in bundle.partitions:
            self.index_partition(partition, force=force)
